about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Maternity of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May this Communion, O Lord, cleanse us of sin, and by the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, the Mother of God, may it make us sharers of heavenly healing. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
